lines: It was morning at the Fuuma mansion.
Me
Zzz... mmm...
Me
Hehe, stop it, Uehara Shikanosuke... If you poke there, it'll tickle... hehe.
What is this...?
You have such a slack face... Master seems to be half‑asleep.
...Excuse me, Master. Please wake up. It's time to get up.
Me
Huh? Hmm...
Someone gently shook my shoulder.
I mumbled and slowly opened my eyes.
Bright sunlight streamed in through the window.
It was a summer morning.
Fresh morning air flowed in through the wide‑open window.
Now then, it's another beautiful day. Breakfast is ready, so please wake up.
Me
Hmm. Mmm... Alright, I'm getting up now...
Me
(Huh? Is that Tsuru or Tokiko? That's rare, they don't usually come to wake me up.)
I thought about it.
Tokiko was my half‑sister and the Fuuma family's butler.
And Tsuru was a pushy maid who had moved in due to certain circumstances.
Both Tokiko and Tsuru constantly tried to take care of me, so
at one point I begged them, "I can wake up alone in the morning!"
and finally earned the freedom to set my own wake‑up time.
Me
(Huh? Then...?)
Still half‑asleep, I lifted my head.
It was neither Tokiko nor Tsuru.
So the woman in the maid outfit beside my bed...?
Ah, that's good. You've woken up. Good morning, Master.
Me
There stood a beautiful maid I didn't recognize.
Kind eyes behind her glasses gazed at me.
No, she wasn't unknown. This person was—.
Me
Whoa!!? Ro... Roberta? What are you doing here!?
Roberta
Oh? What... do you say...?
Roberta
I am the exclusive maid of this mansion— and of my master.
Roberta
Helping you get up like this is only natural♪
Me
I... was that so...?
...No, that was indeed the case.
As my half-asleep mind cleared, I gradually recalled the circumstances.
The beautiful maid's name was Roberta.
Roberta had been working as my personal maid at the Fuuma mansion since yesterday.
It all started with an incident that occurred in a certain Southeast Asian country a while ago.
We received orders from Professor Asagi and carried out a mission in the dark streets of that country.
It was then that we met Roberta and her master, the boy Garcia.
We fought alongside Roberta, who was caught up in the incident, and ended up rescuing their master‑servant pair.
And after the incident.
Garcia, who had always been fascinated by Japanese anime, sent Roberta to obtain rare goods,
and as a token of gratitude for being saved during the incident,
he apparently instructed her to become a maid at the Fuuma mansion during her stay in Japan and take care of me.
Me
(N-no, but...?)
Me
(I'm happy about this situation, but in a way I'm not happy at all...)
Roberta
Um, what's wrong, Master? You're dripping sweat all over your face lazily.
Roberta
Could it be... you wet the bed?
Me
Ah!? No, that's not it! I'm fine, it's nothing! Haha...
Roberta
I see. Is that so.
I shivered and shook my head at the cute maid's question.
Of course I'm thrilled to be taken care of by such a beautiful maid—.
Anyone would think that.
But it was different.
Me
(Y-yeah... I'm really about to lose it...)
I shivered in the bed, trembling as I thought.
Because Roberta was scary.
Me
(This person... with such a gentle face, she's insanely dangerous...)
Roberta
She was a house maid serving the Love-less family, one of the thirteen South American families.
That was only one side of her face.
Roberta had once been called the “Hound of Florencia.”
She was the most terrifying female terrorist who rained blood in the South American war zones.
I had also witnessed her fighting in the recent incident.
Even without ninja techniques, she fought with a terrifying prowess that surpassed even Taimanin.
Above all, her merciless slaughter of enemies was that of a complete killing machine.
If I messed up with someone like her, I'd definitely get a harsh punishment, and if I was unlucky, I'd be killed without question...
That fear made me drenched in sweat from the morning.
Roberta
Now, Master. Your change of clothes is ready. I will assist you.
Me
N-no, I'm ready in time!
Me
Anyway, I'll get up! Thank you for waking me, Roberta!
Terrified, I hurried to stand up—.
Roberta
Oh my, Master. That's... getting up suddenly is dangerous.
Me
Higuu!?
Roberta gently grasped my arm.
Even though she showed no force, I couldn't move a muscle.
It was an incredible power.
What the hell is this person? Is she really human?
Roberta
Now let's get you changed, Master. Don't hold back, this is my job—
Roberta
I always help the young master—Garcia—with changing at the Love-less mansion.
Me
Even if you say that—Whoa! Roberta!?
Roberta skillfully and eagerly strips off my nightgown.
This is bad...
Her real master Garcia is still a boy, so even naked it shouldn't be a problem.
But a guy my age has a certain physiological reaction in the morning—.
Izumo Tsuru
What on earth is happening!?
Me
T- Tsuru!!?
Roberta
She must have heard the commotion.
Then a more troublesome one burst into my room.
Izumo Tsuru
What the hell, from early morning, you and Roberta are naked and flirting...!?
Izumo Tsuru
I can't believe it! This Tsuru is supposed to be by my side, and you let some stray maid we just met today...!
Me
We- we're not flirting! It's... Roberta came to wake me up.
Me
Then she helped me change, and somehow it ended up like this.
I speak while covering myself naked.
What is this? A new kind of play or torture?
Izumo Tsuru
But you're clearly aroused! That's proof!
Tsuru sharply points at my crotch.
Me
Ah, no, it's... it's that physiological thing...
Seeing my flustered state, Roberta quietly nods.
Roberta
I see. Indeed there are signs of heat. ...But don't worry.
Roberta
I serve here only because of Garcia's orders.
Roberta
I'm not interested in you at all, so there's no chance of a mistake.
Izumo Tsuru
What!? You don't understand the good...!?
Izumo Tsuru
Being told you're not interested makes me angry...
Me
No, what the hell do you want...
While saying that and making a fuss, the door of my room slammed open.
Igawa Sakura
What's going on!? Fuuma-kun, are you fighting over another girl again!?
Fuuma Tokiko
Lord... It's fine to make a fuss, but at least wear some clothes.
Ishikawa Amu
Lord! I was watching too!
Me
Ahhh! Shut up! Anyway, you all, get out of the room!
